description:
Activate Saheeli, the Sun's Brilliance by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Atsushi.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Atsushi and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.
